Overview of Canton of Bern Region (Bern / Berne)

Canton of Bern Region (Bern / Berne) is located in the Canton of Bern region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Bern. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Bern UNESCO Old Town & Zytglogge, Jungfraujoch, Eiger & Grindelwald, Lauterbrunnen Valley & Mürren, Interlaken, Lake Thun & Lake Brienz.

RegionCanton of Bern
Capital cityBern
Cities & municipalities69
Primary transport hubBern Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Bern Region

Bern HB rail hub; Bernese Oberland Railway (BOB) to Interlaken, Grindelwald, Lauterbrunnen and Jungfraujoch. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Bern

When visiting cities across Canton of Bern, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Berner Platte
  • Rösti with alpine cheese
  • Meringues from Meiringen
  • Toblerone & Kambly biscuits

Best time to visit Canton of Bern

Best time to visit Canton of Bern: Jun–Sep, Dec–Mar.
